settings.heroTagline: An entire universe created for one person.
settings.heroSubtext: Every second, every galaxy, every heartbeat in this space belongs exclusively to Sampa.

photos.title: The Beginning of Us
photos.caption: The golden autumn day when our universe began and our hearts became one.

photos.title: Coffee Date & Endless Talks
photos.caption: We ordered two cups of warm coffee and talked until the streetlights lit up.

photos.title: Under the Velvet Starlight
photos.caption: Looking up at the constellations and realizing you are my whole sky.

photos.title: Holding Hands in the Rain
photos.caption: When the monsoon shower caught us and neither of us wanted to run inside.

photos.title: Our Spontaneous Roadtrip

photos.title: The Cutest Candid Laugh
photos.caption: Captured mid-giggle when you thought you looked silly, but looked completely ethereal.

memories.title: The Day the Universe Began
memories.summary: 1 October 2022 — The sacred day we started loving each other and our forever story began.
memories.description: October 1, 2022 will forever remain etched as the most significant date in my existence. The moment we knew we loved each other, the noise of the entire world quieted down, leaving only the warmth of your hand in mine. Every second counted since this day is a testament to eternal devotion.

memories.title: Whispering Under Midnight Stars
memories.summary: Lying on a blanket watching shooting stars and sharing our quietest dreams.
memories.description: Wrapped in two oversized jackets and a thermos of hot cocoa, we counted satellites and shooting stars. You pointed to Orion and told me your childhood wishes. That night I realized my only wish was right beside me, shivering cute breaths into the frosty midnight air.

memories.title: Caught in the Summer Storm
memories.summary: Drenched in sudden rain without caring about drenched shoes or messy hair.
memories.description: A sudden downpour caught us halfway between stores. Instead of seeking shelter, you started dancing on the wet cobblestone puddles. I caught your waist and twirled you around while cars passed by splashing water. It remains one of the purest glimpses of heaven I have ever known.

memories.title: Our Secret Sunday Breakfast
memories.summary: Burnt pancakes, spilled syrup, and laughter echoing across the kitchen counter.
memories.description: We tried flipping pancakes and accidentally stuck one to the ceiling edge. You laughed with your eyes crinkling and flour on your nose. Those gentle, ordinary mornings are what real forever is made of.

letters.title: To Sampa, On the Miracle of You
letters.excerpt: There are over eight billion people living on this planet, yet in you, my heart found its singular sanctuary...
letters.content:
My dearest Sampa,

There are over eight billion people living on this planet, each rushing toward their own horizons. Yet among all those souls and coincidences, you crossed my path and turned monochrome days into vibrant color.

Thank you for loving me with patience, for listening to my wildest ideas, and for holding my hand when doubts cloud my mind. Whenever I look at you, I see someone rare, precious, and kind.

I love you more than spoken sentences could ever summarize.

With all my heart,
Your eternal admirer.

letters.title: For the Hard and Quiet Days
letters.excerpt: Open this whenever the world feels heavy and you need a gentle reminder of how deeply cherished you are...
letters.content:
Dearest Sampa,

If you are reading this on a day that felt exhausting or unfair, take a deep breath. Drop your shoulders. Unclench your jaw.

You do not have to be strong every second. You do not have to carry the whole weight of expectations. In my arms, you are always safe to simply exist, to rest, and to let go.

You are resilient, you are brilliant, and you are loved without conditions or deadlines.

Always here, always beside you.

letters.title: Our Next Anniversary Capsule
letters.excerpt: A time-locked sealed letter waiting for our special milestone anniversary date...
letters.content:
Happy Anniversary, my beloved Sampa!

Another full circle around the sun, and another year of choosing each other through every sunrise and midnight conversation.

Look back at everything we built, weathered, and laughed through. I would choose you in every lifetime, in every alternate universe, in every timeline.

Here is to our forever journey ahead!

reasons.title: Your radiant, soul-warming smile
reasons.description: The way your whole face lights up and crinkles at the corners when something genuinely amuses you.

reasons.title: How safe I feel in your presence
reasons.description: In a noisy and exhausting world, simply hearing your voice quiets all internal chaos and brings me peace.

reasons.title: Your immense kindness toward others
reasons.description: The gentle empathy you extend toward strangers, animals, and anyone carrying a heavy burden.

reasons.title: How your hand fits perfectly in mine
reasons.description: As though the contours of our fingers were drafted by celestial architects to interlock without slipping.

reasons.title: Your cute determination when learning something new
reasons.description: That adorable focus expression where you bite your lip slightly when concentrating.

reasons.title: The way you believe in my dreams
reasons.description: Even when I doubt my own strength, your faith in me gives me the courage of a lion.

promises.title: To always listen with an open, tender heart
promises.description: Never just waiting for my turn to speak, but listening to understand your fears, hopes, and quiet sighs.

promises.title: To never let the spark of romance fade into routine
promises.description: To keep bringing you surprise flowers, writing spontaneous notes, and kissing your forehead just because.

promises.title: To stand as your unshakeable shield and safe harbor
promises.description: Whenever storms rise or the world turns cold, my shoulder and arms will always be your unbreakable shelter.

promises.title: To celebrate every one of your victories as my own
promises.description: To cheer the loudest in the front row whenever you step into your brilliance.

secretRoom.hint: Our sacred word combining forever and your name
secretRoom.title: The Hidden Sanctuary of My Heart
secretRoom.secretLetter:
My dearest Sampa,

If you have unlocked this room, you hold the deepest key to my soul. Long before words existed, the universe wrote our story in stardust. No distance, no quiet night, and no passing year could ever diminish how intensely I love you.

Every day with you feels like discovering a new constellation. Thank you for your warmth, your laughter, your gentle gaze, and the way you make the whole chaotic world feel quiet and safe.

This secret corner will always be ours. Whenever you feel overwhelmed by the world, return here to remember: you are cherished beyond human comprehension.

Forever and always,
Your soulmate.
